# Skills

<!-- Generated by `scripts/agents/agentctl skills sync`; edit `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` instead. -->

Canonical source for every harness. Bodies load lazily: harnesses keep only names and descriptions in context until a skill is invoked.

## Agent skills

Model-invoked: an agent loads them when a task matches, in any harness, locally, in T3 Code, or on a GitHub runner. Interactive ones need a human in the loop and are rejected by headless workflows.

| Skill | Use | Interactive |
|---|---|---|
| [code-review](code-review/SKILL.md) | Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or "since X". |  |
| [codebase-design](codebase-design/SKILL.md) | Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary. |  |
| [commit](commit/SKILL.md) | Commit repository changes with FoodSavr conventions. Use whenever you create a git commit. |  |
| [diagnosing-bugs](diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md) | Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow. |  |
| [docs-writer](docs-writer/SKILL.md) | Write and edit human-facing FoodSavr documentation. Use when changing `README.md`, `INDEX.md`, `TODO.md`, `doc/`, `docs/`, or `specs/source-of-truth/` prose. |  |
| [domain-modeling](domain-modeling/SKILL.md) | Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, editing the domain glossary, or recording or editing an ADR. |  |
| [flutter-standards](flutter-standards/SKILL.md) | FoodSavr Dart/Flutter coding standards. Use before writing, refactoring, testing, or reviewing code under `lib/`, `test/`, `integration_test/`, or `packages/`, and when scaffolding a feature. |  |
| [get-it-expert](get-it-expert/SKILL.md) | Expert guidance on get_it service locator and dependency injection for Flutter/Dart. Covers registration (singleton, factory, lazy, async), scopes with shadowing, async initialization with init() pattern, retrieval, testing with scope-based mocking, and production patterns. Use when working with get_it, dependency injection, service registration, scopes, or async initialization. |  |
| [grilling](grilling/SKILL.md) | Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases. | yes |
| [implement](implement/SKILL.md) | Implement an issue, ticket, or spec end to end. Use when asked to build work from an issue, a set of tickets, or a spec, including `triage/ready-for-agent` issues picked up by a runner. |  |
| [issue-creator](issue-creator/SKILL.md) | Create a single GitHub issue (bug, feature, or task). Use when asked to file or open an issue; for a plan split into many tickets use `to-tickets`. |  |
| [localization](localization/SKILL.md) | Add, change, or audit FoodSavr translations with easy_localization. Use when touching user-facing strings, `assets/translations/`, pluralization, or named arguments. |  |
| [pr](pr/SKILL.md) | Open a pull request and write its body. Use when creating a PR or writing or updating a PR body. |  |
| [pr-merge](pr-merge/SKILL.md) | Prioritize the repository's open PRs against a user's objective, coordinate with local and CI agent sessions, and merge finalized PRs in dependency order. Use for Dependabot PR updates and to assess and merge PRs, including mixed-readiness queues and stacks, within the requested scope. |  |
| [prototype](prototype/SKILL.md) | Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like. |  |
| [research](research/SKILL.md) | Research external sources with provider-neutral search, provenance, bounded retrieval, and prompt-injection quarantine. Use for web lookups, standards audits, and source-backed design decisions. |  |
| [resolve-pr-comments](resolve-pr-comments/SKILL.md) | Resolve unresolved review threads on a pull request by fixing, replying, and resolving each. Use when asked to address PR review feedback or comments. |  |
| [tdd](tdd/SKILL.md) | Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests. |  |
| [watch-it-expert](watch-it-expert/SKILL.md) | Expert guidance on watch_it reactive widget state management for Flutter. Covers watch functions (watch, watchIt, watchValue, watchStream, watchFuture), handler registration (registerHandler, registerStreamHandler, registerFutureHandler), lifecycle functions (callOnce, createOnce, onDispose), ordering rules, widget granularity, and startup orchestration. Use when building reactive widgets with watch_it, watching ValueListenables/Streams/Futures, or managing widget-scoped state. |  |
| [wizard](wizard/SKILL.md) | Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself. |  |
| [writing-for-agents](writing-for-agents/SKILL.md) | Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. |  |

## Human skills

User-invoked only (`disable-model-invocation`; Codex/Vibe `allow_implicit_invocation: false`): zero context load until a person types the name. Start with `/skills-guide`.

| Invoke | Use |
|---|---|
| [`/check-loop`](check-loop/SKILL.md) | Run make check, fix what fails, commit, and repeat until green; then push. |
| [`/compress-memory`](compress-memory/SKILL.md) | Compress a document or context while keeping what it must still convey. |
| [`/handoff`](handoff/SKILL.md) | Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up. |
| [`/improve-codebase-architecture`](improve-codebase-architecture/SKILL.md) | Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick. |
| [`/introspect`](introspect/SKILL.md) | Explain which instructions drove a specific action, to improve those instructions. |
| [`/retro`](retro/SKILL.md) | Conduct a retrospective on a coding session. |
| [`/skills-guide`](skills-guide/SKILL.md) | Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over this repository's skills. |
| [`/teach`](teach/SKILL.md) | Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace. |
| [`/to-questionnaire`](to-questionnaire/SKILL.md) | Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in. |
| [`/to-spec`](to-spec/SKILL.md) | Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed. |
| [`/to-tickets`](to-tickets/SKILL.md) | Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker). |
| [`/triage`](triage/SKILL.md) | Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs. |
| [`/wait-what`](wait-what/SKILL.md) | Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it. |
| [`/wayfinder`](wayfinder/SKILL.md) | Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear. |

## Harness projections

| Harness | Discovers | Human skills |
|---|---|---|
| Codex, Vibe | `.agents/skills/` | `agents/openai.yaml` policy |
| Claude Code, OpenCode | `.claude/skills/` (symlinks) | `disable-model-invocation` |
| Copilot | `.agents/skills/`, `.claude/skills/` | `disable-model-invocation` |
| Gemini | `.gemini/skills/` (agent skills) | `.gemini/commands/<name>.toml` |
| Copilot code review | `.github/instructions/<name>.instructions.md` for skills with `metadata.paths` | not projected |

Always-loaded context is `AGENTS.md` only; `CLAUDE.md` and `GEMINI.md` are symlinks to it, and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` is a generated pointer.
